business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Pioneered SLCMs in India in 1992 with "33+ years of proven performance across different terrains and use cases"; deck claims "Highest resale value in the industry owing to superior product quality and strong brand strength".
- SLCM retail market share stated at 75.1% in Q1 FY27, versus 69% in Q1 FY26 and 73.5% for full-year FY26 (deck notes FY26 share of 73.5% came "after dropping to 69% in Q1").
- Deck claims pricing power unique to Ajax: "~2% Price Hike taken in Q4 FY26 despite competitive resistance" and "Ajax remains the only player in the industry to have undertaken a price hike, with no corresponding action observed from competitors thus far", with market share still expanding.
- Distribution moat: "68 Dealers + 64 Service Centres" across 26 states with 132 customer touchpoints, 22 dealers with >5 years of relationship, and "All Dealers are Exclusive to Ajax in the Concrete Equipment Market" (data as of June 2026).
- Innovation claims: "First Indian company to develop and supply Slip-Form Paver and 3D Concrete Printer" — Slip-Form Paver developed entirely in-house in 2019 and 3D Concrete Printing Machine first commercialized in 2023.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Demand environment] The deck attributes FY26 and Q1 FY27 softness to industry headwinds: "Government spending remained below budgeted allocation", "Pace of project execution remained slow" and "Cash disbursement to contractors was delayed", with management adding that Q2 is "expected to remain seasonally soft" and momentum should strengthen in H2.
- [Industry TAM] India's Mechanised Concrete Equipment Industry is projected to grow from Rs 61 bn in FY24 to Rs 178 bn in FY29E, a 24% CAGR; mechanised penetration is projected to reach ~41% of domestic concrete consumption and ~28% of concrete equipment sales volume by FY29.
- [Skilling / R&D] Ajax School of Concrete is a dedicated R&D and training facility running "Specialised training programs for youth on concrete equipment operation, maintenance and safety" and research into "cost-effective and efficient 3D concrete printing solutions" and "optimal concrete mixes tailored for high-performance extrusion and sustainable construction".
- [Customer base] Customers grew from 11,000 in FY22 to 23,000 in FY26 (deck labels "+20%" CAGR) across rental companies, individual contractors, small/mid-sized contracting firms, large construction companies and government construction agencies, with the deck asserting "No customer concentration risk".
